reviews.title: Best Case!
reviews.comment: Upgraded to this from the NZXT H6 Flow case, this one is just a tad smaller and has significantly better build quality with much better air flow and all around better design at a more than fair price.  Incredibly easy to build in even though it's smaller due to just about every panel on this thing being able to come off which is fantastic.  I love Lian Li and the cases they design but I've been wanting something smaller and with this being the smallest case out there that can still fit a Full size ATX Mobo and PSU it's just one of the best cases to come out in the past decade in my opinion.
reviews.author: Tiffany Crabtree

reviews.title: Beautiful case, great price
reviews.comment: The case sold by QuickDealStore came in perfect condition. The case is easily assembled and fits almost all PC components for its compact size. Cables can be hidden in the back cavity especially if using wireless fans. The case overall looks sleek with a 2 glass panel design. Components CPU: Ryzen 7 9800x3d GPU: Sapphire Pulse Radeon rx 9070xt MB: Giggabyte ATX style Fan: LianLi TL Wireless (regular and reverse blade) AIO: LianLi Hydroshift II Tl
reviews.author: Jarod

reviews.title: Excellent Case
reviews.comment: Built my very first gaming PC using this LL case. Plenty of room for cable management. The case is beautiful and great in size for being able to accept mATX and ATX MoBos. With up to 9 fans, there’s plenty of internal airflow. Haven’t had any overheating issues. Installed is a Ryzen 9 9950X3D with a Nvidia 5080 FE
reviews.author: Spidygoat

reviews.title: Quality of Life
reviews.comment: Honestly bought it for looks alone which is already great but the unexpected quality of life features packed throughout this case are great. Easy to work with when you open it up and the cable management is top tier. Looks great and is built incredibly well. Just an overall ease of access to any compartment necessary.
reviews.author: Jack

reviews.title: a wonderful case for my needs.
reviews.comment: Love this case, small enough that it fits perfectly where I wanted it, large enough that I could mount everything I wanted without a problem. I am using 5 Arctic P12 Reverse flow, 1 Reg P12, and Arctic 360 AIO on a Ryzen 7 9800x3d and a rtx 5070 ti, everything is running cool and the air flow is amazing.
